_comment: Snapshot of provider peak/off-peak windows. Verified 2026-11-01. Re-verify at source before trusting the rates.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
notes: All hours outside the listed windows are off-peak, including all weekend.
Chinese public holidays are billed off-peak as well (not modelled here).

zai-glm.label: Z.ai GLM (Coding Plan)
notes: This clock applies to the GLM Coding Plan (points-based quota), not to pay-per-token API billing.
Off-peak calls consume 50% of the standard points; weekends are off-peak all day.
